children.title: Overview
children.summary:
Duo Auth API is available to paying Duo Premier, Duo Advantage, and Duo Essentials
plan customers, Duo Free, and trial accounts.

children.title: About the Auth API
children.summary: Documented properties will not be removed within a stable version of the API.

children.title: First Steps
children.summary:
Before starting:
Sign up for a Duo account if you aren't already a customer.

children.title: API Clients
children.summary:
Duo Security has demonstration clients available on GitHub to call the Duo API
methods.
